units.commission_basis: absolute actual filled quote notional, charged separately on each side
units.funding_basis: absolute open quantity times actual event mark price; signed discrete cash flow
units.CAGR_denominator: entire starting portfolio equity including collateral and idle cash, never just margin used

current_spot_regular_public_table.verification: Official public text extracted 2026-10-02; historic applicability and account rates not proved

current_usdm_regular_table.verification: No records found in public extraction; current applicability UNKNOWN

shared_execution_rules.earliest_order_timestamp: max(decision_timestamp, all_signal_feature_availability_timestamps) + registered_latency; never trade at decision while future flow is being observed
shared_execution_rules.taker_buy_reference: executable ask and available depth at actual arrival, not trade close, mark or index
shared_execution_rules.taker_sell_reference: executable bid and available depth at actual arrival, not trade close, mark or index
shared_execution_rules.partial_depth: cap fill to proven quantity; leave residual unfilled and account opportunity cost
shared_execution_rules.quote_and_depth_availability: exchange timestamp and locally received/server availability bound; reject stale/crossed/negative quotes and future data used in decisions
shared_execution_rules.size_dependent_slippage: max(4bp, causal depth-walk impact bp + separately bounded latency/adverse-move bp); parameters and participation limit must be frozen before outcomes
shared_execution_rules.double_count_protection: Actual ask/bid fills include spread; actual depth fill includes modeled impact. Report spread/impact decomposition but subtract each economic component exactly once. Commission is charged separately.
shared_execution_rules.terminal_positions: close through feasible final executable quotes before common period end and charge all fees/slippage/funding; if no feasible settlement or mark, NOT_EVALUABLE
shared_execution_rules.borrow_funding_interest_rebates_clearanc: never assumed zero for an instrument that incurs them; unavailable inputs produce NOT_EVALUABLE

legacy_proxy_screening.reference: same original causal trade-price proxy accountant and risk

qualification_requires: applicable historical fees or explicitly conservative historical standard-rate bound
actual causal BBO/depth and feasible size/latency treatment
independent venue price, funding/mark/margin where applicable

required_model_components: queue ahead and conservative cancellation treatment
cancel latency and fills during cancellation
actual maker/taker classification for each partial fill
maker and accidental taker applicable fee proof
scenarios.reopen_condition: Required data, registered reusable queue/fill implementation, train-only calibration and independent execution audit; no maker profit claim before those gates

perp_boundary.funding_cashflow: -direction * abs(quantity_at_liability_event) * event_mark * actual_event_rate; positive rate long pays short, negative reverses
perp_boundary.funding_transaction_15second_deviation: conservative ambiguity: charge adverse possible settlement, do not assume beneficial settlement inside uncertainty window
perp_boundary.funding_interval: use verified historical event schedule, not a universal8h assumption
required_data: own perp trades and causal executable BBO/depth
mark and index with availability timestamps
actual historical funding event rates/times and event mark
historical symbol maintenance-margin brackets and clearance fees
collateral denomination, account margin mode and contract specification
perp_boundary.maintenance_margin: calculate on absolute exposure using applicable tiers; mark determines unrealized NAV and liquidation
perp_boundary.unavailable_margin_or_liquidation_inputs: NOT_EVALUABLE; never claim liquidation-free fully collateralized short
perp_boundary.verified_July_funding_samples: BTC/ETH official monthly archives93 events each; funding archive has no mark price, so sample rates alone are not an economic carry replay

null_semantics: UNKNOWN and NOT_EVALUABLE metrics remain null with reasons; no fabricated zero fee, carry, liquidation or fill evidence
